functions.name: contratos_atual
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.contratos_atual(character)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  vcontrato ALIAS FOR $1;
  qtde      integer;
BEGIN
  select count(numero) into qtde
     from contratos
     where (origem = vcontrato);
  RETURN qtde is null or (qtde = 0);
END;$function$
